idea: Compile ralph as a static binary using musl libc by default. The flake.nix should be updated to use a musl-based Rust toolchain (e.g. x86_64-unknown-linux-musl target) so that nix build produces a fully static, portable binary. The default package output should be the static musl build. Ensure cargo check, cargo test, and nix build all work with the musl target. The resulting binary should have no dynamic library dependencies (verify with ldd or file command).
